description: Quote a metered PCC job before running it: price in USD for the given byte count, product, and operation. Read-only and free; returns the quote without charging or reserving anything. First 1 GB free once per IP, then $0.25/GB of input, $1 card minimum. Use before spl_compress on large inputs; use spl_catalog for standing SKUs.

bytes.description: Payload bytes. First 1 GB free once per IP.

dataClass.description: Data class of the payload (e.g. text, logs, json) when known; used to pick the best product. Defaults to unknown.

op.description: Operation: compress, decompress, or roundtrip. Defaults to compress.

product.description: Product to price: auto, zrw, blackjack, shard-zip, shard-tsdb, or slid-phi. Defaults to auto.

name: spl_quote
